subject: general
question: Burmese is the official language of which neighbouring country of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Burmese**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Burmese:-**

 
 
• **​Burmese is the official language of Myanmar (Burma).**
 
• It is spoken by over 33 million people as a first language, and by another 10 million people as a second language.
 
• Burmese is also spoken in neighboring countries such as Bangladesh, India, and Thailand.
